verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's docs name a Skills feature that lets Copilot perform specialized tasks, and separately document custom agents that tailor Copilot's expertise for specific tasks. Both are one-line claims, though, and neither explains how a developer authors or installs a custom skill. MCP server integration is a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation on creating or packaging custom skills, details on where skills apply (IDE, CLI, cloud agent), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
